"Buzz!!" The Movie
is the third live VHS released by Japanese rock duo
B'z
. It was later released on DVD, on March 14, 2001. It received the 1996 Music Video of the Year award at the 10th
Japan Gold Disc Awards
.
[
1
]
The DVD was released at the same time as the single "
Ultra Soul
" as well as three other works by B'z.
